data.name: Long Black-Haired Schoolgirl Survival Simulation Game
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

This is a command-based RPG in which you play as a high school girl who becomes stranded on an uninhabited island.
You must craft tools, secure food, and ultimately find a way to escape.

The original version was released in December 2012 as a Flash game and has been played over one million times.

Since Flash games can no longer be played in modern browsers, this title is a remake designed to run on PC.

The game content has been faithfully ported, with added support for English and Simplified Chinese, and can now be played offline.

Features

  • Various parameters such as moisture, sleep, and illness allow you to experience a realistic survival environment.

  • The island’s layout changes each time you play, providing a fresh challenge on every attempt.

  • Multiple endings and story routes are available.

  • A high degree of freedom—you're free to ignore the scenario and play however you like.

  • When the game ends, a score is displayed, and you can compete with other players online.

About Gameplay Videos and Livestreaming

You are welcome to upload gameplay videos or livestream the game.
Please include the URL of the game’s distribution page in the description of your video or stream.

Support Website

Please refer to the website link on the store page.

Prohibited Actions

  • Modifying the game or creating derivative works

  • Using external tools that provide an advantage in the game

  • Reverse engineering, decompiling, disassembling, or extracting the game’s source code

  • Using any characters, images, text, audio, or program data from this work without permission, regardless of commercial or non-commercial use, individual or corporate

Screenshots of the game and images from the store page may be used freely for thumbnails in videos or streams.

When using images that may contain spoilers, please be considerate of viewers who may unintentionally see them.
